evidenceRule: A proxy callback and its output carrier are separate: strict mode must refuse a typed cache that is not emitted, while compatibility mode only demonstrates historical behavior. Neither the decoder result nor opaque payload round-trip proves proxy rendering, application semantics, DWG, ACIS, or native-CAD acceptance.
